name: K.P. Energy Ltd
title: K.P. Energy Ltd - 539686 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue INR 1,506 cr (+57%) and Q4 EBITDA margin 21%, but operating cash flow fell on inventory build; order book ~2 GW worth ~INR 3,000 cr with ~50% from group entities.

capex.quote: we have the upcoming projects of 100 megawatt each, two projects of 100 megawatt each in the IPP segment

triggers.label: Operating cash flow down on inventory build
triggers.quote: What changed the whole trajectory in term of the operating cash flow was only the inventory count.

triggers.label: Order book ~2 GW, ~INR 3,000 cr
triggers.quote: Our current order book stands at nearly 2 gigawatt across multi-year projects with a total value of approximately INR 3,000 crores

triggers.label: FY27 growth 40-50%
triggers.quote: we are expecting in the coming year and we already have sufficient orders in hand for the same

triggers.label: Q4 IPP generation down YoY
triggers.quote: there is a marginal decrease in terms of the wind performance

guidance.quote: we are expecting in the coming year and we already have sufficient orders in hand for the same

guidance.value: INR 1,700+ cr total project cost, ~INR 450+ cr equity
guidance.quote: roughly we can say that about INR 1,700 plus crores of total both the projects put together will be the project cost

guidance.metric: Interest cost on new IPP debt
guidance.quote: we expected to range between 7.5% to 8.5% depending upon our cycle

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow fell on inventory build

red_flags.label: Half of order book from group entity
